name: Best Logo Slider
author: WPBean

sections.description:
Best Logo Slider is a powerful yet lightweight WordPress plugin that lets you display client logos, partner logos, brand logos, or sponsor logos in a fully responsive logo slider or logo carousel. It’s an ideal solution for businesses, agencies, and professionals who want to build trust and credibility by showcasing brands they work with in a clean and visually appealing way.

This WordPress logo slider plugin allows you to create unlimited logo sliders with ease. Each logo can include an image, title, and optional link, making it perfect for linking to partner websites or brand pages. Using simple shortcodes, you can display the logo slider anywhere on your website, including posts, pages, sidebars, and widget areas, without any coding knowledge.

Designed with performance and responsiveness in mind, Best Logo Slider works seamlessly with most modern WordPress themes and looks great on all screen sizes. Whether you want a rotating logo carousel, a client logo showcase, or a brand slider section, this plugin helps you present your logos professionally while keeping your site fast and user-friendly.

Upgrade to the Pro Version | DEMO | Support

Plugin Features:

  • Responsive Logo slider.
  • Very light weight.
  • Custom post type for logo posting.
  • Logo linking to external link.
  • Show title bellow the logo (You can hide it).
  • No need any settings.
  • Work with all WordPress theme.
  • Easy to use.
  • Developer friendly & easy to customize.
  • Powered by OWL-Carousel.
    & many More

Pro Version Features:

  • Advance setting panel with all necessary settings.
  • Multiple slider can be shown from different logo categories.
  • Slider auto-play, speed, navigation, pagination, color settings.
  • Responsive settings. Can be control logo item to show on tablet & mobile.
  • Show logo title in a tooltip popup.
  • Image size control.
  • WPBakery Page Builder addon.
  • Priority support in our support forum.
  • And many more.
sections.installation:
• Install it as a regular WordPress plugin

  • Active the plugin.

  • Use this shortcode to show logo slider in Page or Post [logo-slider]

  • Template tag for using with custom template

  • Post some logo.
sections.faq:
How can I upload logo image?

The plugin has a custom post type for logo slider. Just post some logo as like as wordpress normal post.

Can I link the logo to external link?

This feature also available with logo post type. You will find a custom logo input box just bellow the logo title.

How can I hide the title bellow the logo image?

Just give a attribute with your shortcode Ex. [logo_slider title=”no”] .
